Registry and charter remain read-only; the dashboard is a public role-safe projection.

T-001.Title: Project and validate maintained portfolio records

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Read the actual ten Registry records, validate states and derive role-safe fields, order and limits; independent fixtures verify shared capacity, Waiting, standing exclusions and unknown dates/measures.

T-002.Title: Render the English dashboard and initiative summaries

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Board, Review, Standing, Roadmap, register, selection and initiative destinations use one derived projection, practical gates, accessible filters and no-script reading with scoped search.

T-003.Title: Render the Russian counterpart and verify real consumer paths

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Reviewed Russian sources, matched controls and themes pass desktop/mobile, keyboard, search, language, no-script and disposable direct-file checks; established site and section checks pass.

T-004.Title: Reconcile approved durable state and publish

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Ownership and verification describe the projection and its boundary; passing fresh evidence permits apply/archive. Commit and push clean source, publish with maintained tool, verify served manifest and bilingual dashboard, preserving concurrent work.
